click.script: selectedThread.value = dataItem.name; messages.filters = { thread: dataItem.name }; messages.reload(); threadMembers.filters = { thread: dataItem.name }; threadMembers.reload(); threadAdmins.params = { thread: dataItem.name }; threadAdmins.reload();

componentProps.text: {{ (() => { const t = (myThreads.data || []).find(t => t.name === selectedThread); if (!t) return 'Select a conversation'; const amPartner = myContext.data && myContext.data.partner; return amPartner ? t.customer : t.partner; })() }}

baseStyles.backgroundColor: {{ (() => { const s = String(dataItem.user || ''); const colors = ['var(--surface-blue-2)', 'var(--surface-green-2)', 'var(--surface-amber-2)', 'var(--surface-red-2)', 'var(--surface-violet-2)']; let h = 0; for (let i = 0; i < s.length; i++) { h = (h * 31 + s.charCodeAt(i)) % colors.length; } return colors[h]; })() }}
baseStyles.color: {{ (() => { const s = String(dataItem.user || ''); const colors = ['var(--ink-blue-8)', 'var(--ink-green-8)', 'var(--ink-amber-8)', 'var(--ink-red-8)', 'var(--ink-violet-8)']; let h = 0; for (let i = 0; i < s.length; i++) { h = (h * 31 + s.charCodeAt(i)) % colors.length; } return colors[h]; })() }}

componentProps.text: {{ (() => { const d = new Date(dataItem.creation); const day = d.getDate(); const suffix = (day % 10 === 1 && day !== 11) ? 'st' : (day % 10 === 2 && day !== 12) ? 'nd' : (day % 10 === 3 && day !== 13) ? 'rd' : 'th'; return day + suffix + ' ' + d.toLocaleDateString('en-US', { month: 'long', year: 'numeric' }); })() }}

componentProps.options: {{ [ { label: 'Make admin', icon: 'lucide-crown', disabled: !(dataItem.side === 'Partner' ? (myContext.data && myContext.data.partner && myContext.data.partner.is_admin) : (myContext.data && myContext.data.customer && myContext.data.customer.is_admin)), onClick: () => { if (!window.confirm('Make ' + dataItem.user + ' the admin?
